stil: Highly detailed 3D animated render in the style of a premium educational science animation, cinematic dramatic lighting, vivid colors, clean realistic materials with subtle subsurface scattering, shallow depth of field, scientifically accurate anatomy, vertical composition with the main subject large and centered. No text, no letters, no labels, no arrows, no watermark, no logo.

gorseller.istem: Dark honeycomb surface inside a hive: a realistic worker honey bee (Apis mellifera: golden-brown fuzzy thorax, abdomen with alternating dark brown and amber stripes, big dark brown compound eyes, six legs, two pairs of transparent wings) performing a waggle dance in the center of the comb, her abdomen tilted up and wagging, the path she traces glowing as a golden-white figure-eight line of light on the comb, a ring of attentive worker bees around her facing her, warm amber light. The animal's face sits in the upper middle part of the frame, with calm empty space in the lower third.
gorseller.not: Dans eden işçi arı ortada, çizdiği sekiz şekli parlayan ışık izi. Etrafında halka olmuş izleyici arılar. Altı bacak, iki çift kanat.
